將下列英文翻譯成中文：（20 分）The diesel engine piston is made of high grade cast iron suitable for high temperature andhigh pressure. The piston head is so shaped as to secure a good combustion. There are fourpiston rings at the upper part of the piston. The piston pin is inserted at its center and oneoil ring each is equipped on its upper and lower side.
